documented_purpose: Applies the chosen qubit layout by relabeling qubit references throughout the circuit.
documentation_source: Qiskit 1.4.6 Transpiler API & Quantum Studio Specification
notes: After a layout pass selects which physical qubits to use, this pass updates all gate references to use the physical qubit indices.

documented_purpose: Inserts a barrier instruction before all measurement operations.
documentation_source: Qiskit 1.4.6 Transpiler API & Quantum Studio Specification
notes: Ensures the compiler does not reorder gates across measurement boundaries, which could change measurement semantics.

documented_purpose: Decomposes non-native gates into the target hardware's native gate set.
documentation_source: Qiskit 1.4.6 Transpiler API & Quantum Studio Specification
notes: Quantum hardware only implements a small set of physical gates (e.g. ECR, RZ, SX, X). Other gates (like H) must be decomposed into equivalent sequences of native gates.

notes: If the circuit uses fewer qubits than the hardware has, this pass assigns the unused physical qubits as ancilla for potential use in routing.

documented_purpose: Finds and removes pairs of inverse gates that cancel each other.
documentation_source: Qiskit 1.4.6 Transpiler API & Quantum Studio Specification
notes: If a gate G is followed by its inverse G†, their combined effect is identity (nothing happens). Removing both reduces the circuit.

documented_purpose: Combines sequences of single-qubit gates on the same qubit into a more compact equivalent.
documentation_source: Qiskit 1.4.6 Transpiler API & Quantum Studio Specification
notes: Consecutive single-qubit gates are mathematically equivalent to a single rotation. Merging them reduces gate execution time and overall error rate.

documented_purpose: Finds a high-quality initial mapping of logical qubits to physical hardware qubits.
documentation_source: Qiskit 1.4.6 Transpiler API & Quantum Studio Specification
notes: A good initial placement minimizes the number of SWAP gates required later. SABRE uses a heuristic look-ahead algorithm to find near-optimal placements.

documented_purpose: Maps logical (virtual) qubits to physical hardware qubits.
documentation_source: Qiskit 1.4.6 Transpiler API & Quantum Studio Specification
notes: Prepares the circuit for the physical coupling constraints of the target hardware by assigning logical to physical qubit indices.

documented_purpose: Maps logical qubit i directly to physical qubit i.
documentation_source: Qiskit 1.4.6 Transpiler API & Quantum Studio Specification
notes: The simplest possible qubit mapping. Suitable for circuits that already match the hardware connectivity or for benchmarking purposes.

documented_purpose: Synthesizes arbitrary unitary matrices into native gate sequences.
documentation_source: Qiskit 1.4.6 Transpiler API & Quantum Studio Specification
notes: When a gate cannot be decomposed via simple rules, its full unitary matrix is synthesized directly into an optimal native gate sequence.

documented_purpose: Attempts to find an isomorphic subgraph mapping between the logical circuit and hardware topology.
documentation_source: Qiskit 1.4.6 Transpiler API & Quantum Studio Specification
notes: If the two-qubit interaction pattern of the circuit can be matched exactly to a connected subgraph of the hardware, no SWAP gates are needed for routing.
